baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 3-5 and 17-19: total gathering across two creature classes plus reciprocal backing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse maximizes agency twice: dispersed visible and hidden actors are assembled, then their constituent parts become mutual supports. Failure therefore survives both total aggregation and distributed cooperation.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed elements supplies the exhaustive aggregation step.
Manifest humankind supplies the publicly accessible domain of agency.
Concealed jinn supply the complementary hidden domain of agency.
Partitive division turns the assembled whole into mutually linked contributors.
Strength gained through an ally's back supplies the coalition's reinforcement mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Humans and jinn cannot individually imitate the Qur'an.
changed_reading.after: Even an exhaustive visible-hidden coalition, internally networked for mutual reinforcement, cannot manufacture an equivalent.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 8-14: the doubled bring-and-equivalence construction around the Qur'an at word 11.
baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated construction tests whether a counterpart can be brought into presence. The Qur'anic root's collecting image and the equivalence root make the target an integrated, recitable whole rather than borrowed fragments or a bare claim of similarity.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply the demand that a claimed counterpart become present.
General equivalence supplies the comparison criterion at both attempt and result.
Collection of parts supplies the requirement that the counterpart cohere as one whole.
Reading and recitation supply the whole's performable verbal form.

changed_reading.before: The challenge asks for another text with similar wording.
changed_reading.after: The challenge asks that a genuinely equivalent, gathered and recitable counterpart be brought into presence as a whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrival of truth in 17:81 coincides with the disappearance of what lacks stability. This revises the focus's repeated bringing language into an arrival test: a produced analogue must not merely appear, but survive exposure to the real.

activation_trace.role: Coming into occurrence supplies the arrival frame for truth.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the property that endures the test.
Departure until no trace remains supplies the result for the unstable rival.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the kind of rival that cannot persist.
The focus's doubled arrival verb transfers the preceding arrival contest into the challenge.
Mutual strengthening tests whether support can preserve an unstable analogue; it cannot.

structural_cues: 17:81 places truth's arrival and falsehood's disappearance before the doubled bringing construction of 17:88.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, stability, disappearance, and the focus's repeated bringing; I supply the arrow that genuine arrival exposes and removes a counterfeit. A live alternative is that 17:81 states a theological contrast without defining the equivalence test.

changed_reading.before: The coalition is unable to produce a similar object.
changed_reading.after: The coalition cannot bring an analogue that remains standing when truth's arrival exposes what has no stable reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: Witnessed recitation, requested authoritative help, and a final sufficient witness create an external warrant and adjudication frame. The focus coalition has only reciprocal parts as support, so it can coordinate effort but cannot bootstrap independent authority or validation.

activation_trace.role: Presence with observation makes the recitation an attested event rather than a private claim.
Compelling proof supplies authority that is more than numerical force.
Aid that makes its object prevail supplies an externally grounded helper relation.
Repeated parts mark the rival support system as closed and reciprocal.
Alliance supplies reinforcement but not an independent warrant.
Complete sufficiency supplies an adjudicator needing no coalition.
Present observation supplies independent testimony at the pericope's close.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies depth unavailable to mutual endorsement.
Inner discernment supplies judgment beyond surface resemblance.

structural_cues: 17:78 marks recitation as witnessed, 17:80 locates authority and help beyond the speaker, and 17:96 closes with a sufficient witness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attestation, compelling authority, effective help, sufficient witness, inward knowledge, and reciprocal creaturely support; I infer a contrast between outside warrant and closed-loop endorsement. Alternatively, these may concern protection and messenger testimony without extending the likeness criterion.

changed_reading.before: Enough cooperating supporters might validate their own successful imitation.
changed_reading.after: Reciprocal backing can amplify a production but cannot furnish the independent authority and penetrating witness by which equivalence is warranted.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 17:82 the Qur'an is delivered and produces opposed outcomes: repair and mercy for one relation to it, increased loss for another. Likeness can therefore be tested as reproducible operation across recipients, not only verbal resemblance.

activation_trace.role: Delivery from above supplies the Qur'an's entry into the recipient field.
Recitation identifies the same performable object later named in the focus.
Recovery and restoration supply one causal outcome.
Tender mercy supplies the beneficial relation accompanying restoration.
Growth supplies the intensification arrow for the opposite recipient outcome.
General diminution supplies that adverse outcome.
The doubled equivalence term makes those operations a possible dimension of comparison.

structural_cues: 17:82 assigns divergent outcomes to the same Qur'anic source according to recipient posture; 17:88 later demands an equivalent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery and differentiated effects; I supply the arrow that a full counterpart may need to reproduce those effects. The live alternative is that 17:82 describes consequences while 17:88 tests only discourse.

changed_reading.before: A rival succeeds by matching linguistic surface or content.
changed_reading.after: A rival would have to match a delivered discourse's differentiated causal action on its recipients, not merely resemble its surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rule in 17:84 that each agent works along its own formative direction limits what gathering can do. Assembly multiplies form-bound capacities; it does not create an agency outside the forms that organize those capacities.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the productive activity later collectivized in the focus.
A governing way and direction supplies the constraint on each actor's work.
Gentle direction toward a way supplies the comparative axis among agent trajectories.
Aggregation tests whether combining constrained agents can exceed their formative limits.
Humankind supplies one class of form-bound producers.
Jinn supply a second class without removing the form constraint.

structural_cues: 17:84 universalizes work according to each actor's direction; 17:88 then universalizes cooperative effort across two actor classes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies form-governed work and later total assembly; I infer that productive constraints persist under aggregation. A live alternative reads the earlier form only as moral disposition, not a limit on composition.

changed_reading.before: Adding more kinds of intelligence should eventually overcome an individual skill limit.
changed_reading.after: The failure is categorical rather than scalar: combining differently formed agencies does not generate an agency outside their received forms.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contrasts recipient-side endowment with attempted production. Knowledge is given only in small measure; revelation is covertly conveyed, removable at its source, lacking a creaturely custodian against removal, and retained as mercy and favor. A coalition of recipients cannot bootstrap the originating source of what it only receives.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the recipients' derivative endowment and contrasts with their later attempted bringing.
Smallness limits the knowledge available to the would-be producers.
Removal and departure make the revealed object withdrawable rather than possessed.
Hidden communication supplies an originating channel inaccessible to ordinary coalition.
A custodian sufficient for an affair supplies the denied creaturely safeguard against removal.
Mercy supplies the exception by which the revelation remains available.
Gift and benefaction supply the non-earned mode of that availability.
Attempted bringing reverses the earlier receiving relation and exposes the source asymmetry.
The recited revelation is the object whose reception cannot be converted into origination.

structural_cues: 17:85 limits endowed knowledge, 17:86 imagines revelation removed, 17:87 excepts its retention as gift, and 17:88 immediately challenges creaturely production.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies limited endowment, hidden conveyance, removability, absent creaturely custody, gift, and attempted bringing; I infer that reception cannot be scaled into origination. Alternatively, 17:85-87 may explain preservation without specifying why imitation fails.

changed_reading.before: The coalition lacks enough intelligence or technique to compose an equivalent.
changed_reading.after: The coalition consists of limited recipients trying to originate a withdrawable gift whose source-channel and custody do not belong to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the challenge, 17:89 describes one Qur'anic whole turning through every kind of example, followed by refusal. The benchmark is therefore not one imitable specimen but a composition capable of coherent internal variation across a total field; the absence of a rival answer coexists with resistant reception rather than a shortage of examples.

activation_trace.role: Turning from state to state supplies internal variation across modes.
Collected wholeness locates those variations within one composition.
Encompassing totality supplies the scope of the varied field.
The illustrative example supplies the units through which the whole varies.
Deliberate refusal supplies the reception-side response despite the available range.
Covering over truth supplies the mode in which refusal masks rather than answers the examples.
General equivalence turns the next ayah's varied examples into a dimension of the challenge.

structural_cues: 17:89 immediately follows the focus and shifts from an equivalent whole to every kind of example within that same Qur'an.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comprehensive variation inside the Qur'an and subsequent refusal; I infer that equivalence includes generative range and that non-response is partly receptive. Alternatively, 17:89 may summarize pedagogy after a narrower literary challenge.

changed_reading.before: Imitation could succeed by matching one representative passage or style.
changed_reading.after: A counterpart would need to remain one coherent whole while generating the internally varied range of examples already present, not merely copy a specimen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The objection and counterfactual in 17:94-95 distinguish the settled recipient population from the messenger commissioned for it and match messenger form to recipient domain. This sharpens the focus from a scale problem into a role problem: aggregating recipient classes does not turn them into the commissioning source of the message.

activation_trace.role: The surface-visible human kind supplies the disputed messenger form.
Messenger and message supply a commissioned role distinct from recipient population.
Angelic kind supplies the counterfactual population and its matched messenger.
Ordinary locomotion supplies inhabitation as a stable recipient condition.
Settled repose supplies the condition defining the counterfactual population.
The matched angelic messenger confirms role correspondence without collapsing sender and recipients.
Humankind supplies one recipient-side class in the attempted coalition.
Jinn supply the second class without changing the coalition's originating role.

structural_cues: 17:94 rejects a human messenger form; 17:95 answers by matching an angel messenger to a hypothetically settled angel population.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recipient populations and commissioned messenger forms; I infer that adding recipient classes cannot promote them into the source role. A live alternative is that the exchange defends messenger embodiment only and does not bear on composition.

changed_reading.before: The challenge fails because the coalition is not large or diverse enough.
changed_reading.after: No increase in recipient diversity changes the coalition's role: recipients and messengers do not become the source that commissions the message.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the post-challenge demand list as a failed inventory of substitutes rather than merely requests for signs. It remains anchored because the list immediately follows the focus's bring-an-equivalent construction and culminates in a readable book. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory structural analogy, not as an explicit equation made by the ayat.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 8-14 require an equivalent to be brought; context 17:90-93 repeatedly requests brought, released, fallen, elevated, and written deliverables.

activation_trace.role: Bringing into presence anchors the outlier's comparison with the requested deliverables.
Equivalence supplies the criterion those spectacular substitutes fail to address.
Water emerging from a source supplies the first material deliverable.
Wide splitting and outflow intensify the demanded hydraulic production.
A detached fragment supplies the demanded celestial object.
Ornament and gilding supply the demanded luxury object.
Ascent supplies the demanded transport into the upper realm.
Ordered writing supplies the list's final textual deliverable and closest false substitute.

changed_reading.before: The following demands are unrelated miracle requests after a literary challenge.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the demands enumerate spectacular outputs that can be delivered without becoming an equivalent gathered discourse; even the final written object is only a carrier, not the counterpart.

strongest_changes: The immediate truth-and-falsehood sequence turns imitation into an arrival-and-survival test, not simple appearance.
The limited, withdrawable, gifted status of revelation reframes failure as recipient-source asymmetry rather than insufficient technique.
The next ayah expands likeness from a single specimen to one whole capable of coherent variation through every kind of example.
External authority and penetrating witness cannot be bootstrapped from reciprocal creaturely backing.
summary.what_was_special: The focus concentrates totalization, equivalence, collection, and mutual support; the context repeatedly changes the relevant axis from amount of agency to source, operation, internal range, warrant, and commissioned role while preserving the focus's production anchor.
remaining_uncertainties: The operational-effects model depends on treating healing, mercy, and loss as dimensions of equivalence rather than consequences only.
The form-bound agency model may overextend an ethical disposition into a compositional constraint.
The recipient-source and external-warrant models are strongly sequenced but still rely on reader-supplied arrows from context into the likeness criterion.
The spectacular-substitute outlier should remain explicitly exploratory.
